subject.title: Dashboard: editable notes / todo / markdown widget (stateful)

question: Should OpenClaw accept a bundled stateful notes builtin as part of the dashboard roadmap, or keep this as an external/custom widget once the write-back API exists?
rationale: The current repository does not ship the dashboard substrate yet, and VISION.md supports web frontend ergonomics while also keeping optional plugin/bundled promotion high-bar, so the permanent product boundary needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Review the linked PR stack
options.body: Keep this issue paired with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101829 and decide it after the write-back dependency at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101329 is resolved.

options.title: Externalize the widget
options.body: Ask for the notes experience to ship as a custom dashboard widget or ClawHub package after the dashboard/widget API exists.

options.title: Pause the roadmap item
options.body: Leave this issue open but blocked until maintainers decide whether the modular dashboard roadmap should continue in bundled OpenClaw.

recommendation.title: Review the linked PR stack
recommendation.body: Keep this issue paired with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101829 and decide it after the write-back dependency at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101329 is resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent plugin-tab history and CODEOWNERS ownership make this the best available routing candidate, though final product ownership is not proven solely from history.
